interface.shortDescription: CTO skills and artifacts for startups.
interface.longDescription: Day Zero CTO helps early-stage technical leaders run the operating loop from a project-level knowledge wiki in Codex Desktop or Claude Code: onboarding, context setup, tech stack mapping, hard decisions, weekly reviews, CEO updates, risk reviews, CTO-level code review, Python-first helper scripts, install doctor checks, spaced-repetition learning with a mastery checklist, structured JSON-to-HTML report templates, durable HTML reports with dated index references, company-aware index context, collapsible Core Context/Reports/Learning/Help/Misc sections, help commands, cadence alerts, and a bookmarkable local index at knowledge/wiki/index.html.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me run Day Zero CTO for this startup.
